# `ingress.interval_s` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Interval in seconds between two background runs of the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `300` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | ingress |
| Unit | s |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `ingress.interval_s` only if you observe problems with the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[ingress]
interval_s = 300
```

[d0406] PaderQueue 3.0 release notes (type: changelog | version: 3.0)

- **Changed default:** `ingress.interval_s` now defaults to `5` (previously `300`). - **Changed default:** `snapshotter.max_connections` now defaults to `512` (previously `256`).

- **Changed default:** `metrics.interval_s` now defaults to `10` (previously `300`).

- **Changed default:** `scheduler.log_level` now defaults to `info` (previously `error`).

## New features

- New option `retention.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.

- New option `ingress.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST starts throttling.

- New error code PQ-E1441 (COORDINATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E4572 (QUOTA_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `broker.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues, in bytes.

- New option `metrics.log_level`: log verbosity of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.

- New option `acktracker.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.

# PQ-E1944 RETENTION_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `retention: work queue full`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 2.2

## What it means
The internal work queue of the retention is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `retention.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# PQ-E2187 PARTITIONER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `partitioner: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the partitioner is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `partitioner.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

# PQ-E1547 PARTITIONER_COMPONENT_DISABLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `partitioner: component disabled`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 1.1

## What it means
A request needed the partitioner, but the partitioner is switched off.

## Common causes
- A slow disk
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Enable the component by setting `partitioner.enabled` to `true` and restart the node.

[d0915] pq snapshot describe (type: cli | version: 4.x)

# `pq snapshot describe`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Describes a snapshot.

## Usage
```
pq snapshot describe <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--since` | Only consider objects created after this timestamp (ISO 8601). |
| `--wait` | Block until the operation is completed on all nodes. |
| `--include-internal` | Also show internal system objects (names starting with `__`). |
| `--tenant` | Name of the tenant the command applies to. |

## Example
```
pq snapshot describe orders --since
```

# `scheduler.log_level` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Log verbosity of the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time.

# PQ-E4426 SCHEDULER_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: retries exhausted`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The scheduler gave up after reaching the configured maximum number of retry attempts.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Check the logs for the underlying failure first. If the failures are transient, increase `scheduler.max_retries`.

# `retention.threshold_percent` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `90` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | retention |
| Unit | % |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `retention.threshold_percent` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[retention]
threshold_percent = 90
```

[d0538] retention.batch_size (PaderQueue 3.x) (type: config | version: 3.x)

# `retention.batch_size` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Number of messages the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period processes together in one batch.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `32` |
| Available since | 2.0 |
| Component | retention |
| Unit | messages |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `retention.batch_size` only if you observe problems with the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[retention]
batch_size = 32
```

# Postmortem INC-2024-106: inventory-sync degraded

**Duration:** 12 minutes
**Impact:** Failed requests in `inventory-sync`

During the incident, `inventory-sync` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E4875 repeatedly.

- T+3: On-call engineer found PQ-E4875 in the broker logs.
- T+6: The team rolled back the last client deployment.
- T+12: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a configuration change during a deployment.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E4875.
- Add an alert for this error code.

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: component disabled`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.2

## What it means
A request needed the quota, but the quota is switched off.

- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Enable the component by setting `quota.enabled` to `true` and restart the node.

# Postmortem INC-2025-220: inventory-sync degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 25 minutes
**Impact:** Failed requests in `inventory-sync`

## Summary
During the incident, `inventory-sync` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E4875 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `inventory-sync` fired.
- T+6: On-call engineer found PQ-E4875 in the broker logs.
- T+12: The team rolled back the last client deployment.
- T+25: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a new client version with a retry bug.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E4875.
- Add an alert for this error code.

[d0611] spool.interval_s (PaderQueue 3.x) (type: config | version: 3.x)

# `spool.interval_s` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Interval in seconds between two background runs of the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `60` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | spool |
| Unit | s |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `spool.interval_s` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[spool]
interval_s = 60
```

[d0240] compactor.worker_threads (PaderQueue 3.x) (type: config | version: 3.x)

# `compactor.worker_threads` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Number of worker threads used by the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `8` |
| Available since | 3.1 |
| Component | compactor |
| Unit | threads |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `compactor.worker_threads` only if you observe problems with the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[compactor]
worker_threads = 8
```

# PQ-E2771 DLQ_OPERATION_TIMEOUT

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `dlq: operation timeout`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
An operation of the dlq did not complete within the configured timeout.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Check network latency and load on the involved nodes. For slow but healthy clusters, increase `dlq.timeout_ms`.

# PaderQueue 1.1 release notes

Released on 2021-07-19.

## New features

- New option `scheduler.batch_size`: number of messages the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time processes together in one batch.

- New option `metrics.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.

- New option `snapshotter.enabled`: turns the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues on or off.

- New option `auth.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the authentication module that validates client tokens waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `dlq.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `partitioner.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written before an operation is reported as failed.

- New error code PQ-E1616 (PARTITIONER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.

- New option `replicator.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

- New option `retention.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling.

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `128` |

```toml
[spool]

```

retrieved.chunk_text:
[d0107] PQ-E3108 SPOOL_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED (type: error | version: 4.x)

# PQ-E3108 SPOOL_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `spool: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.1

## What it means
The spool refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `spool.max_connections`.

[d0439] acktracker.queue_capacity (type: config | version: 4.x)

# `acktracker.queue_capacity`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `5000` |
| Available since | 2.2 |
| Component | acktracker |
| Unit | tasks |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `acktracker.queue_capacity` only if you observe problems with the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
queue_capacity = 5000
```

# PQ-E2400 SPOOL_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `spool: retries exhausted`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.2

## What it means
The spool gave up after reaching the configured maximum number of retry attempts.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Check the logs for the underlying failure first. If the failures are transient, increase `spool.max_retries`.

# Postmortem INC-2024-106: inventory-sync degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 12 minutes
**Impact:** Failed requests in `inventory-sync`

## Summary
During the incident, `inventory-sync` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E4875 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `inventory-sync` fired.
- T+3: On-call engineer found PQ-E4875 in the broker logs.
- T+6: The team rolled back the last client deployment.
- T+12: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a configuration change during a deployment.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E4875.
- Add an alert for this error code.

[d0903] compactor.compression (PaderQueue 2.x) (type: config | version: 2.x)

# `compactor.compression` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Compression codec that the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages uses for stored or transferred data.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: none | lz4 | zstd |
| Default | `none` |
| Available since | 2.0 |
| Component | compactor |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `compactor.compression` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[compactor]
compression = "none"
```

# PQ-E2771 DLQ_OPERATION_TIMEOUT

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `dlq: operation timeout`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
An operation of the dlq did not complete within the configured timeout.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Check network latency and load on the involved nodes. For slow but healthy clusters, increase `dlq.timeout_ms`.

[d0650] PQ-E4895 REPLICATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH (type: error | version: 4.x)

# PQ-E4895 REPLICATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `replicator: codec mismatch`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
Two nodes of the replicator use different compression codecs and cannot read each other's data.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Set `replicator.compression` to the same value on all nodes, then restart them one after another.

[d0285] partitioner.max_retries (type: config | version: 4.x)

# `partitioner.max_retries`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of retry attempts of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `3` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | partitioner |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `partitioner.max_retries` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[partitioner]
max_retries = 3
```

Check the logs for the underlying failure first. If the failures are transient, increase `partitioner.max_retries`.

# `dlq.max_retries` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of retry attempts of the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `8` |
| Available since | 2.3 |
| Component | dlq |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `dlq.max_retries` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[dlq]
max_retries = 8
```

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `3` |
| Available since | 2.3 |
| Component | dlq |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## Notes

Changes to `dlq.max_retries` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[dlq]
max_retries = 3
```

# `spool.max_connections`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `1024` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | spool |

retrieved.chunk_text:
[d0107] PQ-E3108 SPOOL_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED (type: error | version: 4.x)

# PQ-E3108 SPOOL_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `spool: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.1

## What it means
The spool refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `spool.max_connections`.

# `pq queue describe`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Describes a queue.

## Usage
```
pq queue describe <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--include-internal` | Also show internal system objects (names starting with `__`). |
| `--retain-days` | Number of days the result is kept before it is deleted automatically. |
| `--timeout` | Seconds to wait for the operation to finish. Default: 30. |

## Example
```
pq queue describe orders --include-internal
```

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

```
pq token move <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|

| `--max-parallel` | Maximum number of nodes processed at the same time. Default: 2. |
| `--force` | Skip the confirmation prompt. |

## Example
```
pq token move orders --label
```

# Runbook: ingress troubleshooting

> Operations runbook

This runbook covers the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST.

## Health check
1. Run `pq node describe <node> --output json` and check the `ingress` section.
2. Look at the `paderqueue_ingress_errors_total` metric.

## Relevant settings
- `ingress.batch_size`
- `ingress.buffer_bytes`
- `ingress.interval_s`
- `ingress.log_level`
- `ingress.threshold_percent`
- `ingress.compression`
- `ingress.queue_capacity`
- `ingress.timeout_ms`

## Escalation
If the problem persists for more than 30 minutes, escalate to the platform team.

- New option `compactor.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `quota.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.

- New error code PQ-E3108 (SPOOL_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `auth.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the authentication module that validates client tokens.

- New option `ingress.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST.

- New option `metrics.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics, in bytes.

- New error code PQ-E4590 (SNAPSHOTTER_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `auth.log_level`: log verbosity of the authentication module that validates client tokens.

- New option `scheduler.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time.

[d0356] PQ-E1944 RETENTION_WORK_QUEUE_FULL (type: error | version: 4.x)

# PQ-E1944 RETENTION_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `retention: work queue full`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 2.2

## What it means
The internal work queue of the retention is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `retention.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

retrieved.chunk_text:
[d0721] PQ-E2137 DLQ_THROTTLED (type: error | version: 4.x)

# PQ-E2137 DLQ_THROTTLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `dlq: throttled`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 1.2

## What it means
The dlq is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `dlq.threshold_percent`.

retrieved.chunk_text:
[d0174] PQ-E2617 DLQ_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED (type: error | version: 4.x)

# PQ-E2617 DLQ_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `dlq: retries exhausted`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 1.0

## What it means
The dlq gave up after reaching the configured maximum number of retry attempts.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check the logs for the underlying failure first. If the failures are transient, increase `dlq.max_retries`.

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `acktracker: buffer exhausted`

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the acktracker is full and new data is rejected.

- A slow disk

Reduce the incoming rate or increase `acktracker.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

# `scheduler.log_level`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Log verbosity of the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: debug | info | warn | error |
| Default | `info` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | scheduler |
| Default changed | in 3.0 (see release notes) |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `scheduler.log_level` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[scheduler]
log_level = "info"
```

```toml

max_retries = 10
```

# PQ-E1405 BROKER_THROTTLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `broker: throttled`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.1

## What it means
The broker is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `broker.threshold_percent`.

# PQ-E3221 BROKER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `broker: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 1.0

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the broker is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `broker.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

Maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |

Changes to `replicator.max_connections` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

```toml
[replicator]
```

# Postmortem INC-2025-220: inventory-sync degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 25 minutes
**Impact:** Failed requests in `inventory-sync`

## Summary
During the incident, `inventory-sync` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E4875 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `inventory-sync` fired.
- T+6: On-call engineer found PQ-E4875 in the broker logs.
- T+12: The team rolled back the last client deployment.
- T+25: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a new client version with a retry bug.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E4875.
- Add an alert for this error code.

[d0435] PQ-E4030 AUTH_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED (type: error | version: 4.x)

# PQ-E4030 AUTH_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `auth: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The auth refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `auth.max_connections`.

# PQ-E1783 AUTH_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `auth: retries exhausted`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The auth gave up after reaching the configured maximum number of retry attempts.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check the logs for the underlying failure first. If the failures are transient, increase `auth.max_retries`.

an operation is reported as failed. - New error code PQ-E3788 (COMPACTOR_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message. - New error code PQ-E2771 (DLQ_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.

[d0204] PQ-E4582 RETENTION_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED (type: error | version: 4.x)

# PQ-E4582 RETENTION_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `retention: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 1.0

## What it means
The retention refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `retention.max_connections`.

# `compactor.interval_s`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Interval in seconds between two background runs of the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `5` |
| Available since | 3.1 |
| Component | compactor |

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `compactor.interval_s` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[compactor]
```

# Postmortem INC-2025-220: inventory-sync degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 25 minutes
**Impact:** Failed requests in `inventory-sync`

## Summary
During the incident, `inventory-sync` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E4875 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `inventory-sync` fired.
- T+6: On-call engineer found PQ-E4875 in the broker logs.
- T+12: The team rolled back the last client deployment.
- T+25: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a new client version with a retry bug.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E4875.
- Add an alert for this error code.

[d0359] PQ-E4934 SPOOL_THROTTLED (type: error | version: 4.x)

# PQ-E4934 SPOOL_THROTTLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `spool: throttled`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 1.0

## What it means
The spool is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `spool.threshold_percent`.

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `retention: operation timeout`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
An operation of the retention did not complete within the configured timeout.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Check network latency and load on the involved nodes. For slow but healthy clusters, increase `retention.timeout_ms`.

[d0806] PQ-E2995 QUOTA_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED (type: error | version: 4.x)

# PQ-E2995 QUOTA_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: retries exhausted`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The quota gave up after reaching the configured maximum number of retry attempts.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Check the logs for the underlying failure first. If the failures are transient, increase `quota.max_retries`.

[d0604] PaderQueue 3.1 release notes (type: changelog | version: 3.1)

# PaderQueue 3.1 release notes

Released on 2024-01-15.

## New features

- New option `acktracker.batch_size`: number of messages the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed processes together in one batch.

- New error code PQ-E1176 (INGRESS_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.

- New option `coordinator.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers.

- New option `spool.log_level`: log verbosity of the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.

- New option `compactor.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.

- New option `broker.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues starts throttling.

- New option `coordinator.enabled`: turns the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers on or off.

- New option `compactor.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.

- New option `dlq.enabled`: turns the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue on or off.
